title: Original geometric-stalk exchange on total strict-local cohomology
statement: Let Λ be a commutative coefficient ring, X′→P¹_S and X′→T a pullback square over g:T→S [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T separably closed geometric points with ι:Spec k′→Spec k and ι≫σ=τ≫g [def-weil-geometric-point]. Choose an algebraically closed Ω and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with eA:Spec A≅S_(νισ) and eB:Spec B≅T_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Write jA=eA≫j_(νισ), jB=eB≫j_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Suppose φ:A→B is local and ρA:Spec k→Spec κA, ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB satisfy Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ and ρB≫Spec(κφ)=ι≫ρA, where rA,rB are closed-point maps. For any torsion Λ-module étale sheaf F on P¹_S [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], set F0=(P¹(jA))^*F. For every $q\geq0$ write $G_0$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of $F_0$ and $\widetilde\varphi:\mathbf P^1_B\to\mathbf P^1_A$ for the map induced by $\varphi$. There are additive equivalences $c_1$ from the original source stalk at $\tau$ to $H^q(\mathbf P^1_A,G_0)$ and $c_2$ from the original target stalk at $\tau$ to $H^q(\mathbf P^1_B,\widetilde\varphi^{-1}G_0)$ such that $c_2(\mathrm{Ex}(x))=\widetilde\varphi^*(c_1(x))$ for every $x$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. This conclusion involves only the original geometric stalks and total-space cohomology, and no local closed-point stalk or closed-fibre comparison.

proof.text: Use properness for qcqs and inverse-image stalks to identify the original source stalk with the higher-direct-image stalk at sigma. Extending the separably closed fields to Omega leaves pointed neighbourhood stalks unchanged. The strict-henselization stalk formula and pullback universal properties then give c1 and c2 as equivalences to cohomology of the two total strict-local projective lines. This is only the original-stalk side; do not use the analogous formula over A and B.

For module coefficients compare via an injective module resolution and acyclicity of its underlying abelian sheaves. The Cech argument for this acyclicity applies at the universe of Λ; it does not assert that the forgetful functor preserves injectives. The existing encoding of injective module sheaves uses a coefficient ring in Type u, whereas this statement requires the same argument at Type (u+1), with the ModuleCat encoding. This coefficient-universe bridge is part of this intermediate, not supplied by the narrower existing Lean signature.

Use the termwise exchange formula: on each pointed neighbourhood it restricts sections along the base-changed projection. The pointed residue and structural squares identify the projections over phi by pointed-lift uniqueness. Exact filtered colimits and homology give c2 Ex = H(phi) c1 on total strict-local cohomology. Pullback uniqueness transports from the standard projective line over T to X prime. This step does not identify either cohomology group with a local higher-direct-image stalk or a closed fibre.

theorem Etale.projectiveLine_originalStalk_totalCohomologyExchange
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {S T X' : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S} {f' : X' ⟶ T} {g' : X' ⟶ ProjectiveLine S}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) g)
    {k k' Ω : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [Field k'] [IsSepClosed k']
    [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (σ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (τ : Spec (.of k') ⟶ T)
    (ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (hι : ι ≫ σ = τ ≫ g)
    (ν : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of k'))
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ))
    (eB : Spec (.of B) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme (ν ≫ τ))
    (φ : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (ρA : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (ρB : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)))
    (hφ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ eA.hom ≫
        strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) =
      eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) ≫ g)
    (hρA : ρA ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)) ≫
      eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ) = σ)
    (hρB : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue B)) ≫
      eB.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ τ) = τ)
    (hρ : ρB ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)) = ι ≫ ρA)
    (F : Sheaf (ProjectiveLine S).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [IsTorsionSheaf F] (q : ℕ) :
    let F₀ := (ProjectiveSpace.map _
      (eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap (ν ≫ ι ≫ σ)))^*[
      ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F
    let G₀ := (sheafCompose _
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F₀
    let g₀ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
    ∃ (c₁ : ((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
          ((Etale.baseChangeSourceFunctor Λ g (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) q).obj F) ≃+
        Sheaf.H G₀ q)
      (c₂ : ((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
          ((Etale.baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ g' f' q).obj F) ≃+
        Sheaf.H ((ProjectiveSpace.map _ g₀)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}].obj G₀) q),
      ∀ x, c₂ ((((pointSmallEtale τ).sheafFiber
          (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
          (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q F)).hom x) =
        Etale.cohomologyMap (ProjectiveSpace.map _ g₀) G₀ q (c₁ x)
